lanes.purpose: Observable unit sales, product prices and industry economics.
lanes.limitations: Excavator, auto/NEV, pork and cement conditions; no exhaustive physical-industry crawl.
Government/Xinhua reposts and contemporaneous financial reporting used selectively.

sourceItems.title: 工业和信息化部向基础电信运营企业发放5G系统试验频率使用许可
sourceItems.publisher: 工业和信息化部（中央网信办转载）
normalizedClaims: MIIT issued 5G mid/low-band trial-frequency permits to China Telecom, China Mobile and China Unicom, enabling trial base-station deployment and signaling a concrete next step in 5G industrialization.
observedChanges: 5G moves from generic policy expectation to operator-specific trial spectrum and deployment.

sourceItems.title: 国务院办公厅关于保持基础设施领域补短板力度的指导意见
sourceItems.publisher: 国务院办公厅（财政部公开）
normalizedClaims: The State Council called for maintaining infrastructure short-board investment while explicitly retaining local-government debt and project-cash-flow constraints.
observedChanges: policy stance shifts toward supporting infrastructure while keeping financing discipline.

sourceItems.title: 国内挖掘机销售18万台创新高，三一独占鳌头
normalizedClaims: Jan-Nov excavator industry sales reached roughly 185k units; November sales rose 14.9% YoY.
Sany Jan-Nov excavator sales were 43,036, about +54% YoY; November Sany sales +25% and share about 24.3%.
The industry described 2019 as moving from high growth toward high-base steady growth, i.e. a later-cycle state.
observedChanges: physical demand remains positive while cycle maturity becomes explicit.

sourceItems.title: 1至11月我国新能源汽车产销保持稳步增长
normalizedClaims: Jan-Nov overall auto sales fell 1.65% YoY and passenger-vehicle sales fell 2.77%, while NEV sales grew 68% to roughly 1.03m.
November NEV sales were roughly 169k, +37.6% YoY, showing clear product-level divergence from the weak broad auto market.
observedChanges: NEV demand remains strong while the broad auto market contracts.

sourceItems.title: 第四季DRAM合約價二次下修，2019年第一季跌幅持續擴大
normalizedClaims: DRAM prices had officially reversed downward in Q4; November contract prices were revised lower again.
Q4 average selling prices were down roughly 8%, with standard/server/specialty DRAM declines near 10%, and 2019Q1 declines were expected to widen.
observedChanges: the DRAM super-cycle rolls into an oversupply/price-downcycle.

sourceItems.title: 2018年11月份居民消费价格同比上涨2.2%
normalizedClaims: November pork prices were -1.1% YoY and -0.6% MoM.
NBS attributed part of the monthly decline to ASF-affected producing regions accelerating hog sales, so the later scarcity price regime was not yet present.
observedChanges: disease narrative exists but realized consumer pork pricing remains weak.

sourceItems.title: 1400亿！全国均价上涨超百元 行业利润创新高 2018“石头”很疯狂！
normalizedClaims: Through Nov 20, the national average cement price was about RMB430/t, +31% YoY, and the national cement price index reached a historical high.
Industry profits through August were already RMB96.3bn, +1.5x YoY and above full-year 2017 profits, while East-China winter supply controls pushed some local prices above RMB600/t.
observedChanges: cement pricing/profits are at very high levels with additional winter supply restriction.

sourceItems.title: 在民营企业座谈会上的讲话
normalizedClaims: Policy called for substantial tax reductions, lower social-insurance burden, addressing private-enterprise financing difficulty, expanding financing channels and allowing local relief funds for viable firms under stress.
observedChanges: policy support for private-enterprise financing and tax burden becomes explicit.

eventClusters.statement: China issued operator-specific 5G trial-frequency permits, converting a generic 5G roadmap into a concrete spectrum/deployment prerequisite but not yet proving commercial capex or supplier earnings.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Trial spectrum is a real operational step but remains one stage before commercial licenses and broad capex. Deep research must require supplier order/earnings evidence and account for any prior 5G thematic rerating.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any A-share 5G supplier have a measurable company earnings/order bridge by Dec 31, or should spectrum allocation remain Research/No selection?

eventClusters.statement: Infrastructure support policy strengthened while November excavator sales remained +14.9% and Sany +25%, but the industry itself described a shift from high growth toward high-base steady growth.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Physical demand remains positive, but cycle maturity and high 2018 growth make expectation/duration tests critical. Do not assume infrastructure support recreates an early-cycle setup.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can leader share/earnings and valuation still justify selection despite explicit cycle maturity?

eventClusters.statement: Broad auto/passenger-vehicle sales were contracting while NEV sales remained strongly positive, so the aggregate auto signal must be decomposed into conventional-auto weakness and NEV-specific demand.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: NEV growth can be subsidy/policy sensitive and not every supplier converts sector units into earnings. Deep research must separate product demand from company quality/valuation.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Do NEV leaders show company-specific earnings/share evidence strong enough to overcome broad-auto weakness?

eventClusters.statement: DRAM contract prices had clearly reversed into decline by Q4, with November pricing revised down again and 2019Q1 deterioration expected to deepen.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Keep a negative physical memory signal separate from any domestic-semiconductor narrative; positive selection requires a distinct company/product engine.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Should generic A-share memory exposure fail closed at Dec 31?

eventClusters.statement: ASF was disrupting the hog market, but November pork prices remained negative YoY/MoM and accelerated slaughter in affected regions temporarily increased supply.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Future scarcity is plausible but not yet reflected in the frozen physical price signal; do not leak 2019 outcomes backward.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there any producer-specific pre-cutoff earnings/ASP evidence strong enough to override weak physical pork pricing?

eventClusters.statement: Cement prices and industry profits were already at historical highs while winter supply restrictions tightened East-China availability, creating strong current earnings but also obvious peak-cycle/expectation risk.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: High spot prices/profits may already be fully known and winter supply controls are seasonal. Deep research must test whether valuation/earnings gap remains rather than equating record profit with a buy signal.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any efficient cement leader retain under-reflected earnings/valuation room at Dec 31?

eventClusters.statement: Central policy explicitly intensified tax, financing and relief support for private enterprises under stress, but the event is broad and company outcomes depend on leverage, pledge risk and business quality.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Broad support does not create equal earnings improvement. Do not map indiscriminately to distressed private stocks.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a coherent investable subset with measurable financing-cost/survival-to-earnings transmission, or should the broad event remain unselected?
